placeholderProtocol.lookup: The Asset resolver checks the selected public export. A missing file renders the matching same-ratio placeholder.

identityInvariants: Same face, age, skin tone, hairline, hair mass, brow shape, eye scale, nose and neat light beard.
Navy open overshirt, white crew-neck T-shirt, beige cuffed chinos and navy sneakers with white laces and sole.
Natural slim body; no child proportions or bodybuilder anatomy.
Acting comes from torso, hands, feet, balance and prop interaction.
No generic presenter pose as the default.
No text, logo, fake phone screen or dashboard baked into a render.
ownerSystem.watchHandRule: The dark smartwatch stays on the same real hand in every pose. Never mirror a whole Owner render.

requiredCompanions.contactShadow: Separate when floor contact is visible
requiredCompanions.foregroundMatte: Separate when a hand or arm overlaps a device or card

unresolvedVisualBoardDecisions: B08 must confirm the final Who-Is-It-For acting pose for OWNER_THINKING.
GROUP 14 must approve owner-relaxed or owner-standing-confident as OWNER_FORM.
B08 must decide whether OWNER_FINAL requires dedicated RTL/LTR exports instead of the neutral owner-closing-crop record.
